name: Yellow sweetclover
desc: Ribbed Melilot (Melilotus officinalis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Melilotus officinalis, known as sweet yellow clover, yellow melilot, ribbed melilot and common melilot, is a species of legume native to Eurasia and introduced in North America, Africa, and Australia.
